subject: Post-discovery: schedule demo + dedicated pool sizing for MPAC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@mpac.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule demo + dedicated pool sizing for MPAC

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive and a dedicated capacity sizing session: 

1) Goals from MPAC: low sub-150ms 95th latency for synchronous classification flows, sustained 200 reqs/s at peak for batch enrichment, and 6–8B token/day KV cache budget.
2) Next sessions we propose: a) 60m product demo focusing on end-to-end flows + instrumentation (Ben to lead), b) 75m dedicated capacity sizing (throughput/latency) with ops and infra (Evelyn + Ben).
3) Pre-work: please share any existing load profiles or samples (QPS, typical sequence lengths, percent of streaming vs single-shot) — we attached a short CSV template to make that quick.

Availability: we have the following windows this week and next — please pick one for the sizing call, and we’ll put the demo the following day if that works for you:
- Wed Jul 4 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Jul 5 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Jul 9 — 13:00–15:00 PT

If none of those work, send a couple of slots and I’ll coordinate. I’m copying Ben and Evelyn for technical coverage.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@mpac.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mpac.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 18:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule demo + dedicated pool sizing for MPAC

Thanks Jordan — great overview and appreciate the structured next steps.

Quick answers:
- Throughput: baseline 75 reqs/s now, expected peak spikes to ~220 reqs/s during batch runs (15–30min windows).
- Latency target: 95th <150ms for the sync classification path; async enrichment can tolerate 500–800ms.
- Payload: average sequence length ~120 tokens; 99th ~420 tokens for a small subset of long documents.

We can do the sizing call on Thu Jul 5 at 09:00 PT — that works for Priya and me. Please send calendar invite and the CSV template referenced. I attached our quick load snapshot (mpac_live_snapshot.json) — it’s a small file summarizing the last 7 days.

One ask: Priya will want a checklist of evidence items for our security review (SOC/retention/audit log questions). Can you confirm who on your side handles compliance artifacts so we can loop them in during the sizing call if necessary?

Alex

Perfect — I’ve booked Thu Jul 5, 09:00–10:30 PT for the dedicated sizing session and scheduled the product demo for Fri Jul 6, 11:00–12:00 PT so the teams don’t have to reconvene twice. Calendar invites attached (calendar_invite-dedicated-sizing.ics).

Pre-call items:
- Attached: mpac_throughput_template.csv (small CSV with QPS by endpoint, seq length distribution, and burst profiles). Please populate the highlighted rows before the sizing call — that will let Ben and Evelyn prepare model variant and batching recommendations.
- We’ll also bring a draft mutual action plan (attached) with milestones and responsibilities; feel free to suggest edits in the docx.
- Compliance: copying our Information Security lead, Evelyn Hart, who will answer the SOC/retention/audit log checklist live (and follow up with artifacts post-call).

Ben, Evelyn — FYI, MPAC will share the populated CSV and a short snapshot Alex attached. Priya will be on the sizing call for compliance questions.

If anything changes, tell me and I’ll update invites.

Cheers — Jordan

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mpac.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule demo + dedicated pool sizing for MPAC

Thanks all — confirmed on our side. We uploaded the completed mpac_throughput_template.csv to the Drive link you provided and shared access to the snapshot Alex mentioned. Priya here (Head of Integrations) — quick items for the call:

- We’ll highlight two critical endpoints for the sizing exercise (classify_text and enrich_entities). Expect the following 95th latencies today: classify_text ~120–140ms; enrich_entities ~340–420ms under burst.
- We’d like to walk through fallback behavior: if dedicated pool saturates, what are recommended routing policies and graceful degradation?
- Please also outline any KV cache sizing assumptions for warm start-up behavior — we are sensitive to cold-start bursts.

Looking forward to the session.

— Priya Shah
Head of Integrations, MPAC
priya.shah@mpac.com | +1 (212) 555-0192
